title: FemTheme Solo #020 · 여 레전더리 바스트·인스타글램·간호사 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in an empty sunlit stadium with green turf, a running track, standard-height gates and low stands behind her, warmly lit by the low golden sun, long soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in warm golden-hour sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult American woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, sun-kissed skin, heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, shimmery bronze eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline, a confident, camera-ready smile, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in flat glossy finger waves styled close to the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long copper chain ending in one large faceted aquamarine drop, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (an iron teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver hammer head, a silver square-sided cowbell, a gold chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single gold anklet. Extremely long almond nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide; a mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body, the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it; below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves; her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust; the bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a white nurse cap with a small red cross and a stethoscope draped around her neck, a white silk scarf folded into the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and knotted in a small knot at the side of her bust right beside one breast, one end of the silk trailing long down her side and the other end cut short, fully opaque and covering only what it must, and a minimal white silk micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
SUBJECT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme white ballet heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the warm low sun in glowing glints, the golden light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
